title: Rust
label: Rust
desc: Fast, memory-safe systems language built around ownership and zero-cost abstractions.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the toolchain and compile a first program.

snippets.code:
# Install rustup, the toolchain manager, then the stable toolchain
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh
rustup update stable
rustup component add clippy rustfmt

# Check what is installed
rustc --version
cargo --version

# Compile and run a single file without Cargo
rustc main.rs -o hello
./hello

# Optimized build
rustc -O main.rs -o hello

sections.title: Cargo
sections.description: Project layout, dependency management and the everyday build commands.

snippets.code:
cargo new greet --bin
cd greet

cargo check            # type-check quickly without producing a binary
cargo run              # build and run
cargo build --release  # optimized build in target/release
cargo test             # every test target
cargo add serde --features derive

[package]
name = "greet"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }

[profile.release]
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
